Sprint 8 design spec for InkOS — Payroll + 1099-K + tax compliance. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`. Continue Sprint 1-7 language exactly.

Inputs:
- Migration live: `supabase/migrations/20260416000006_payroll_tax.sql` (5 tables: payroll_runs, payroll_artist_summary, tax_forms, artist_tax_info, payroll_payment_batches; 11 RPCs; encrypted TIN storage via pgcrypto)
- Handoff: `.handoffs/sprint-8-dato-migration.md`
- Feature gate: Pro tier+ (`payroll`, `tax_forms_1099k`)
- Integration: commission_records and commission_adjustments get `payroll_run_id` enforcing link

**Sprint 8 scope to design:**

1. **Payroll hub** at `/payroll` — tabs: Runs / Artists Tax Info / 1099-K Forms
   - **Runs tab (default)** — List of payroll runs (reverse chron). Columns: period (M/YYYY), status pill (draft/calculated/approved/paid/cancelled), artist count, total gross, total net, created/approved/paid dates, actions. "+ New Run" CTA (defaults to prior month).
   - **Artists Tax Info** — Artists list with W-9 status column: "Submitted Mar 2026" / "Not submitted" (red badge). Click → W-9 collection form.
   - **1099-K Forms** — Table per tax year + artist: status, gross, threshold met badge, PDF, sent status. "Generate 1099-Ks for [year]" CTA (January-only).

2. **New Payroll Run wizard** — Modal or page at `/payroll/runs/new`:
   - Step 1: Period (from/to date, pre-filled prior month). "Use last month" button.
   - Step 2: Preview eligible records: counts + per-artist preview (N commission records, $X total). "Continue".
   - Step 3: Review + label. Submit → creates `draft` → runs `calculate_payroll_run` RPC → redirects to `/payroll/runs/[id]`.

3. **Payroll run detail** at `/payroll/runs/[id]`:
   - Header: label, period, status pill, total gross/commission/tips/adjustments/net (big stats row), artist count, record count
   - Timeline: draft → calculated → approved → paid (with timestamps + who)
   - Actions by status:
     - `draft` → "Calculate" (runs RPC)
     - `calculated` → "Approve" or "Recalculate" or "Cancel"
     - `approved` → "Mark Paid" (opens payment modal)
     - `paid` → read-only (no edits per trigger)
   - **Per-artist summary table**: artist name (snapshot), commission count + total, tips, adjustments, gross, net, payment method, paid status per-artist, row actions (mark paid individually)
   - **Commission records drill-down** — collapsible section: all commission records in this run (readonly link to `/commissions/records/[id]`)
   - **Adjustments drill-down** — adjustments linked to this run

4. **Mark Paid modal** — When owner marks run paid:
   - Payment method select (cash/check/ach/dodo_connect/external/other)
   - Payment reference input (e.g., "ACH Batch 2026-03")
   - Paid date picker (default today)
   - Optional notes
   - Warning: "This locks the payroll run. No further edits allowed." 
   - If dodo_connect selected: "We'll trigger Dodo Connect payouts for each artist with a linked Dodo account." (Dodo Connect is a future wire — for now placeholder)

5. **W-9 collection form** at `/artists/[id]/tax-info` (owner/admin only):
   - Legal name (may differ from display_name)
   - Legal entity type: radio (individual, sole_prop, LLC, S-Corp, C-Corp, partnership, other)
   - TIN type (SSN/EIN/ITIN/VAT/ABN) + TIN input
   - Address (jsonb — street, city, state, zip, country)
   - Country dropdown (default US)
   - Backup withholding checkbox
   - FATCA exempt checkbox (for certain entity types)
   - Exempt payee code input (optional)
   - W-9 signer name (required)
   - "Save & Lock" button → calls `set_artist_tax_info` RPC (server-side encryption).
   - Post-save: shows masked TIN (last 4 only) + "Edit" link (re-collects TIN, creates new encrypted record).
   - Audit log of who collected/reviewed the info.
   - Security callout: "TIN is encrypted at rest. Only studio owners can decrypt when generating tax forms."

6. **1099-K generation flow** (January only, per tax year):
   - Card on `/payroll` hub: "Generate 1099-K forms for 2026 (due Jan 31)."
   - Click → preview table: artists meeting threshold ($600 gross in 2026), plus artists under threshold (shown for reference, not generated).
   - Per-artist row: gross amount, transaction count, threshold_met badge.
   - "Generate" → calls `generate_1099k` RPC → creates tax_forms rows status=draft.
   - Post-gen: table of generated forms with "Review & Send" action.

7. **1099-K review + send** at `/payroll/tax-forms/[id]`:
   - Form preview rendering (PDF embed or custom layout)
   - Artist legal name + TIN last4 (if collected) + address
   - Box 1a: gross amount; Box 1b: card not-present (blanks); transaction count
   - Studio as payee info
   - "Generate PDF" → enqueues worker job @react-pdf/renderer → writes to `tax-forms` bucket → updates `tax_forms.pdf_storage_path`
   - "Send to artist" → emails PDF via Resend worker → updates `sent_at` + `sent_to_email`
   - "Void" → creates correction + marks original voided (allowed until locked_at).
   - "Lock" → sets `locked_at` — no further edits.

8. **Correction workflow** — correction_of FK: clicking "Issue Correction" on a sent 1099-K → creates new draft linked via correction_of → editor lets you fix numbers → submit + send.

9. **Feature gate (Pro tier+)** — Solo/Studio see `UpgradeGate` with "Payroll + 1099-K unlocks at Pro tier — $99/mo". Sidebar "Payroll" item hidden for Solo/Studio (permissions).

10. **Artist-side view** — artist sees their `payroll_artist_summary` rows (Sprint 7 pattern). Artist profile Performance tab adds "Payroll History" section: list of paid-out summaries + date + amount + method + reference.

11. **Empty states:**
    - No runs yet: "No payroll runs. Create your first run to pay out approved commissions."
    - No W-9s: "No tax info collected yet. Collect W-9s from artists who earn $600+ in a year."
    - No 1099-Ks: "Generate 1099-K forms in January for artists who hit the $600 threshold."

12. **Toast templates:**
    - Payroll run created / calculated / approved / paid / cancelled
    - Artist marked paid
    - W-9 saved (note: "TIN is encrypted.")
    - 1099-K generated / sent / voided / locked

13. **Permissions matrix updates** — from Sprint 6 `role_permissions`: payroll.* and tax_forms.* grouped. Owner+admin only. Receptionist: no. Artist: view own only.

14. **Copy clarity** — Payroll + tax are intimidating. Use plain-English inline help:
    - "Calculate": "Tally up all approved commissions in the period."
    - "Approve": "Lock the calculated totals. Commissions can't be added or removed after this."
    - "Mark Paid": "Record that you've sent payments to artists. This finalizes the run."
    - "1099-K": "US tax form reporting payments to artists who earned $600+ in a year. File with IRS + send to artist."

**Hard rules (locked Sprints 1-7):**
- `text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight` page titles, `tabular-nums` everywhere
- Dark-first, electric-purple, skeletons match layout
- 6 states per data component
- base-nova `render` not `asChild`
- CSS `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*` sidebar
- 4px grid, max 3 font sizes per page
- `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
- Money in cents, `formatCurrency` everywhere
- Zero raw hex outside brand
- All mutations → Sonner toast

**Deliverables — write to `.handoffs/sprint-8-design-spec.md`:**
1. `/payroll` 3-tab hub layout
2. New run wizard flow (3 steps)
3. Run detail page layout with per-artist table
4. Mark Paid modal
5. W-9 collection form with security messaging
6. 1099-K generation + review + send flow
7. Correction workflow
8. Feature gate (Pro+) appearance
9. Artist-side Payroll History on Performance tab
10. Empty states + copy
11. Toast templates
12. Permissions matrix updates
13. Plain-English copy for payroll + tax jargon
14. Component inventory
15. Build sequence for Koda (14-16 linear items)

Keep actionable.

1	# Sprint 8 — Dato Migration Handoff
2	# Payroll + 1099-K + Tax Compliance
3	**Migration:** `20260416000006_payroll_tax.sql`
4	**Date:** 2026-04-16
5	**Feature gates:** `payroll` (Pro+), `tax_forms_1099k` (Pro+)
6	
7	---
8	
9	## Table Inventory
10	
11	| Table | Owned by | RLS Scope | Direct Write |
12	|-------|----------|-----------|--------------|
13	| `payroll_runs` | `studio_id` | Studio member SELECT; owner/admin INSERT/UPDATE; draft-only DELETE | Yes (via RLS) |
14	| `payroll_artist_summary` | `studio_id` + `payroll_run_id` | Owner/admin + artist-own-row SELECT; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE blocked | RPC only |
15	| `tax_forms` | `studio_id` | Owner/admin SELECT; INSERT/UPDATE blocked; draft-only DELETE | RPC only |
16	| `artist_tax_info` | `studio_id` | Owner/admin SELECT; INSERT/UPDATE blocked; DELETE owner only | RPC only |
17	| `payroll_payment_batches` | `studio_id` | Owner/admin SELECT; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE blocked | RPC/service-role |
18	
19	### Deferred FK enforcement (Sprint 7 → Sprint 8)
20	- `commission_records.payroll_run_id` → `payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
21	- `commission_adjustments.payroll_run_id` → `payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
22	
23	---
24	
25	## RPC Contracts
26	
27	All RPCs are `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`.
28	
29	### `create_payroll_run(p_studio_id, p_period_start, p_period_end, p_label?) → uuid`
30	- Auth: owner or admin
31	- Feature gate: `payroll`
32	- Creates `status = 'draft'` run. Returns run id.
33	- Raises `payroll_runs_studio_period_unique` if duplicate period.
34	
35	### `calculate_payroll_run(p_run_id) → jsonb`
36	- Auth: owner or admin
37	- Idempotent: re-running clears existing summaries, un-links records, recalculates.
38	- Aggregates: `commission_records` (status='approved', created_at in period) + `commission_adjustments` (status='approved', applied_at in period), both where `payroll_run_id IS NULL`.
39	- Writes: creates `payroll_artist_summary` rows, links records/adjustments, sets run totals + `status = 'calculated'`.
40	- Returns: `{ run_id, status, artist_count, record_count, total_gross, total_net }`
41	
42	### `approve_payroll_run(p_run_id) → boolean`
43	- Auth: **owner only** (not admin)
44	- Transition: `calculated` → `approved`
45	
46	### `mark_payroll_paid(p_run_id, p_method, p_reference?) → boolean`
47	- Auth: **owner only**
48	- Transition: `approved` → `paid`
49	- Side effects: sets `commission_records.status = 'paid'` for all linked records; sets `payroll_artist_summary.status = 'paid'` for pending summaries.
50	
51	### `cancel_payroll_run(p_run_id, p_reason?) → boolean`
52	- Auth: **owner only**
53	- Blocked if status = `paid`
54	- Side effects: nulls `payroll_run_id` on linked commission_records and adjustments; status → `cancelled`.
55	
56	### `mark_artist_payment(p_summary_id, p_method, p_reference?, p_paid_at?) → boolean`
57	- Auth: owner or admin
58	- Per-artist payment tracking; sets `payroll_artist_summary.status = 'paid'`.
59	
60	### `generate_1099k(p_studio_id, p_tax_year) → SETOF jsonb`
61	- Auth: **owner only**
62	- Feature gate: `tax_forms_1099k`
63	- Threshold: $600 (60,000 cents) per IRS guidance.
64	- Data source: `payments` table (Studio 4) via `payments.booking_id → bookings.artist_id`, filtered by `succeeded_at` in tax year.
65	- Idempotent upsert: `ON CONFLICT (studio_id, artist_id, tax_year, form_type, correction_of)` — skips update if `locked_at IS NOT NULL`.
66	- Returns one jsonb row per form created/updated.
67	
68	### `get_payroll_run_detail(p_run_id) → jsonb`
69	- Auth: any studio member
70	- Returns: `{ run: {...}, artist_summaries: [...] }` — see `PayrollRunDetail` interface in types.ts.
71	
72	### `set_artist_tax_info(p_artist_id, p_tin_type, p_tin_plaintext, ...) → boolean`
73	- Auth: owner or admin
74	- Encrypts TIN via `pgp_sym_encrypt(tin, key)` where key = `current_setting('app.settings.tin_encryption_key')`.
75	- Stores `tin_last4` as plaintext last 4 digits only.
76	- Upserts `artist_tax_info`. Audit logs the action (without plaintext TIN).
77	- **Never pass TIN via URL or log it.**
78	
79	### `get_artist_tax_info_masked(p_artist_id) → jsonb`
80	- Auth: owner or admin
81	- Returns all fields except `tin_encrypted` (always null). Shows `tin_last4` only.
82	- Use for display in UI.
83	
84	### `decrypt_artist_tin(p_artist_id) → text`
85	- Auth: **owner only**
86	- Decrypts via `pgp_sym_decrypt(tin_encrypted, key)`.
87	- Mandatory audit log on every call.
88	- **Call only during 1099 PDF generation.** Never for display.
89	
90	---
91	
92	## Encryption Approach
93	
94	TIN (SSN/EIN/ITIN) is encrypted using pgcrypto's `pgp_sym_encrypt`:
95	
96	```sql
97	-- Store
98	tin_encrypted = pgp_sym_encrypt(p_tin_plaintext, current_setting('app.settings.tin_encryption_key'))
99	
100	-- Retrieve (owner only, audit logged)
101	pgp_sym_decrypt(tin_encrypted, current_setting('app.settings.tin_encryption_key'))
102	```
103	
104	Key classification: **L4 (Restricted)** — never in code, env files, or logs.
105	
106	### GUC Requirement (CRITICAL — Koda must configure)
107	
108	The key lives in the database config as a GUC (Grand Unified Configuration parameter):
109	
110	```sql
111	ALTER DATABASE postgres
112	  SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = 'your-32-char-secret-key-here!!';
113	```
114	
115	**Three ways to set it:**
116	
117	1. **Supabase Dashboard** → Settings → Database → Configuration
118	   Add: `app.settings.tin_encryption_key = 'your-key'`
119	
120	2. **Direct SQL** (via Supabase SQL editor, owner credentials):
121	   ```sql
122	   ALTER DATABASE postgres SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = 'key';
123	   ```
124	
125	3. **Admin API endpoint** (Koda implements):
126	   ```
127	   POST /api/admin/set-encryption-key
128	   Body: { key: "..." }
129	   ```
130	   This calls the ALTER DATABASE statement server-side using the service role client.
131	   Env var: `TIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` — read on server startup.
132	
133	**Key rotation procedure:**
134	1. Decrypt all TINs with old key via `decrypt_artist_tin()`.
135	2. Re-encrypt with new key via `set_artist_tax_info()`.
136	3. Update the GUC with new key.
137	4. Verify a spot-check decryption.
138	
139	---
140	
141	## Payroll Lifecycle
142	
143	```
144	draft
145	  ↓ calculate_payroll_run()
146	calculated
147	  ↓ approve_payroll_run()      [owner only]
148	approved
149	  ↓ mark_payroll_paid()        [owner only]
150	paid                           [LOCKED — prevent_paid_payroll_modification trigger]
151	  
152	  (any non-paid status)
153	  ↓ cancel_payroll_run()       [owner only]
154	cancelled
155	```
156	
157	### Idempotency
158	`calculate_payroll_run()` can be called multiple times on draft/calculated runs. Each call:
159	1. Deletes all `payroll_artist_summary` rows for the run.
160	2. Nulls `payroll_run_id` on linked records/adjustments.
161	3. Re-aggregates from scratch.
162	
163	This means calling calculate twice is safe — same result.
164	
165	### Commission record lifecycle within payroll
166	```
167	commission_records.status
168	  approved → [assigned to run by calculate_payroll_run]
169	  approved + payroll_run_id set → [run marked paid]
170	  paid + [run cancelled] → approved (via sync_commission_payroll_status trigger)
171	```
172	
173	---
174	
175	## Tax Form Lifecycle (1099-K)
176	
177	```
178	(run generate_1099k RPC)
179	draft [auto-skipped; RPC creates as 'generated']
180	  ↓
181	generated
182	  ↓ (PDF attached, send to artist)
183	sent
184	  ↓ (if correction needed)
185	corrected   ← new row with correction_of = original row id
186	  ↓ (IRS file submitted)
187	locked_at = now()  ← immutable after this point
188	```
189	
190	### locked_at enforcement
191	The RLS UPDATE policy blocks all direct updates. The `generate_1099k` RPC honours `locked_at` in its upsert:
192	```sql
193	status = CASE WHEN locked_at IS NOT NULL THEN status ELSE EXCLUDED.status END
194	```
195	Once locked, even the RPC won't overwrite fields.
196	
197	### Cross-period corrections
198	To issue a corrected 1099-K:
199	1. Call `generate_1099k` which creates a new row with correct amounts.
200	2. Manually set `correction_of = <original_form_id>` and `status = 'corrected'`.
201	3. Void the original form (`status = 'voided'`).
202	
203	Both rows share the same unique constraint key via `correction_of` nulls-not-distinct distinction.
204	
205	---
206	
207	## Koda Gotchas
208	
209	### 1. TIN encryption — never log plaintext
210	```typescript
211	// NEVER
212	console.log('TIN:', tinPlaintext)
213	logger.info({ tin: tinPlaintext }) // BANNED
214	
215	// SAFE
216	logger.info({ tin_last4: maskedInfo.tin_last4 })
217	```
218	
219	### 2. locked_at — gate all UI edits on this field
220	```typescript
221	// Before showing edit UI for a tax form:
222	if (form.locked_at) {
223	  return <LockedFormBadge />
224	}
225	```
226	
227	### 3. Payroll idempotency — calculate before display
228	After calling `calculate_payroll_run`, the `payroll_runs.record_count` and totals are authoritative. Never compute totals client-side from commission_records.
229	
230	### 4. Artist summary — read-only for clients
231	All four DML operations on `payroll_artist_summary` are blocked by RLS (`WITH CHECK (false)`). Use RPCs (`mark_artist_payment`) for any writes.
232	
233	### 5. Feature gate — check before rendering payroll UI
234	```typescript
235	// In server component or API route:
236	const { data: hasPayroll } = await supabase
237	  .rpc('check_feature_access', { p_studio_id: studioId, p_feature_key: 'payroll' })
238	
239	if (!hasPayroll) redirect('/billing?upgrade=payroll')
240	```
241	
242	### 6. generate_1099k uses payments table (Sprint 4)
243	The RPC joins `payments → bookings → artists`. Any payments without a `booking_id` (e.g., manual deposits) are excluded from 1099-K gross. This is intentional — 1099-K covers only card-processed payments.
244	
245	### 7. Cron jobs — worker/cron implements these
246	Two scheduled jobs are documented in the migration (Section 8):
247	- `generate-1099k-forms`: Jan 15, 09:00 UTC annually
248	- `draft-monthly-payroll`: 1st of every month, 08:00 UTC
249	
250	The cron service in `workers/cron/` must add these. The RPC calls are the actual implementation.
251	
252	---
253	
254	## TypeScript Types (lib/supabase/types.ts)
255	
256	New exports added:
257	
258	**Table row types:**
259	- `PayrollRun`, `PayrollRunInsert`, `PayrollRunUpdate`
260	- `PayrollArtistSummary`
261	- `TaxForm`, `TaxFormInsert`
262	- `ArtistTaxInfo`
263	- `PayrollPaymentBatch`
264	
265	**Union types:**
266	- `PayrollRunStatus` — `'draft' | 'calculated' | 'approved' | 'paid' | 'cancelled'`
267	- `PayrollArtistStatus` — `'pending' | 'paid' | 'held' | 'disputed'`
268	- `TaxFormType` — `'1099-K' | '1099-NEC' | 'T4A' | 'P60' | 'custom'`
269	- `TaxFormStatus` — `'draft' | 'generated' | 'sent' | 'corrected' | 'voided'`
270	- `TinType` — `'ssn' | 'ein' | 'itin' | 'vat' | 'abn' | 'other'`
271	- `LegalEntityType`
272	- `PaymentMethodType` — `'cash' | 'check' | 'ach' | 'dodo_connect' | 'external' | 'other'`
273	- `PayrollBatchStatus`
274	
275	**RPC return interfaces:**
276	- `PayrollCalculationResult`
277	- `TaxForm1099KResult`
278	- `PayrollRunDetail` (with `PayrollArtistSummaryDetail`)
279	- `ArtistTaxInfoMasked`
280	
281	---
282	
283	## RLS Audit
284	
285	| Table | rowsecurity | SELECT | INSERT | UPDATE | DELETE |
286	|-------|-------------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
287	| payroll_runs | enabled | member | owner/admin | owner/admin | owner/admin (draft only) |
288	| payroll_artist_summary | enabled | owner/admin + artist-own | blocked | blocked | blocked |
289	| tax_forms | enabled | owner/admin | blocked | blocked | owner/admin (draft+unlocked) |
290	| artist_tax_info | enabled | owner/admin | blocked | blocked | owner only |
291	| payroll_payment_batches | enabled | owner/admin | blocked | blocked | blocked |
292	
293	---
294	
295	## Migration Stats
296	
297	- New tables: 5
298	- New FK constraints enforced: 2 (Sprint 7 deferred)
299	- New indexes: 18
300	- New triggers: 5 (updated_at x4 + audit_payroll_run_status + prevent_paid_payroll_modification + update_commission_payroll_link)
301	- New RPCs: 11
302	- Migration line count: ~1,050

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`
45
